meta.name: muapi-product-campaign
meta.description: Generate a full multi-channel product campaign — hero visuals, social media assets, short ad video, and platform-specific crops for an end-to-end launch campaign.

copy.tagline: 一键生成多渠道产品营销活动素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速产出产品营销所需的视觉和视频素材。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a full multi-channel product campaign in one go
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce visual and video assets for a product campaign.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 根据产品名称、核心信息和目标受众，生成一套完整的多渠道营销素材，包括主视觉图、社交媒体图、短视频以及适配不同平台的裁剪版本。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作产品营销活动、发布推广或品牌宣传时触发，例如提到“产品活动”、“营销活动”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我为Nova Pro无线耳机做一个产品发布活动。
say.note: 技能会收集产品名称、信息、受众等参数。

say.text: 生成一套包含主视觉、视频和平台裁剪的营销素材。
say.note: 技能会并行生成所有素材。

howto.what_en: Generates a full multi-channel product campaign including hero visuals, social media assets, short ad video, and platform-specific crops based on product name, campaign message, and target audience.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a product campaign, launch campaign, or marketing campaign, e.g., mentioning 'product campaign' or 'campaign assets'.

say_en.text: Create a product launch campaign for Nova Pro Wireless Earbuds.
say_en.note: Skill will ask for product name, message, audience, etc.

say_en.text: Generate a full campaign set with hero image, video, and platform crops.
say_en.note: Skill runs all phases in parallel.
